checks.factual: All modified facts and retained siblings read in their full sets. Primary source records compared with stated claims; independent primary checks below cover replacement/disputed technical, chronology, rule, museum and media facts. Direct fetch limitations stated.
checks.translation: Every EN/ET prompt, public explanation, response, host alternative and title read; matching identity/qualifiers verified. Natural localized proper names, inflections and conventional technical terminology accepted. Final supplied aliases and sea-snail noun rechecked after corrections.
checks.independence: All five siblings read for every affected ordinary category, plus four single Finals. Direct answer disclosure, given aliases, finite stroke/chess/major-tournament pools and upper-tier supplied-answer definitions addressed. Reveal order does not supply the required remaining identification.
checks.difficulty: Easy replacements retain recognizable sports, instruments, films and design objects. Higher tiers require actual technical, artistic, historical or cultural identity/terminology. Tier1 in Hard can be accessible while later questions require deeper knowledge.
checks.attribution: Original factual bilingual wording and citation-only corroboration are distinct from source licence labels. Actual Wikipedia CC-BY-SA labels retained; reserved primary pages retain copyright terms; USGS factual text public domain with third-party media excluded. No copied source media or lyrics.
checks.structure: Snapshot/projected comparison passed for category difficulty, IDs, counts, tier, enabled and all membership/order. Sparse content/source changes only.
